before_cl.name: dinov2-unadapted
before_cl.pooling: uniform mean over the three planes

exposed.name: the published 4-block baselines, trained WITH the 56 gold studies
exposed.note: Identical in every argument except the cohort manifest. These are the runs behind the 0.7105 headline in gold-probe-extended-v3.

unexposed.checkpoint_selection_note: best.pt, selected on validation Recall@1 over the 433-study holdout validation split. That R@1 is NOT comparable to the published 0.1383, which is over 441 candidates; never place them in one table.
unexposed.name: 4-block adaptation trained WITHOUT the 56 gold studies (gold-holdout-v1)
unexposed.note: Encoder never saw these studies as training pairs nor through checkpoint selection.

bootstrap.limitation: resampling studies is not resampling patients; anonymisation is per study, so patient identity is unverifiable

config.cohort_note: The cohort manifest pinned here defines the study population and the preprocessed images only, both identical to contrastive-cohort.jsonl. It differs from it solely in that the 56 gold studies carry split 'excluded' instead of train/validation. The exposed arm's checkpoints were trained on contrastive-cohort.jsonl; the unexposed arm's on this one. Scoring both here is what makes the contrast paired.

comparisons.confound: The unexposed arm also trained on 48 fewer studies (3,478 vs 3,526) and selected over 433 rather than 441. Dropping training data can only hurt, so a null needs no control; only a drop does. See the protocol.
comparisons.primary: exposed/uniform_mean_768 versus unexposed/uniform_mean_768, paired over the same 56 studies, the same folds and the same study resamples, via scripts/compare_downstream_arms.py. Pre-registered: unexposed at or above exposed means exposure did not materially inflate 0.7105; unexposed materially below means every probe figure in digest/ needs relabelling.
comparisons.reference: before_cl/uniform_mean_768 (unadapted DINOv2, 0.6438) is the floor both arms are read against.

config.estimand: PRIMARY: pooled paired difference in macro out-of-fold AUROC, unexposed minus exposed, across three matched seeds, bootstrapped over studies using the SAME resample indices for both arms and resampling the per-study difference. This measures how much of the published 0.7105 is exposure inflation. The unexposed arm alone is the project's first gold-probe number that is an estimate of generalisation rather than a development statistic -- at study level, not patient level, since patient identity is unverifiable.

metrics.environment_note: sklearn 1.8 deprecates the explicit penalty=l2 argument pinned above and removes it in 1.10. The fitted model is unchanged, since l2 is the default; a rerun on 1.10 must translate it to l1_ratio=0 rather than silently dropping it.
metrics.primary: pooled out-of-fold AUROC per label, macro-averaged over the 12 labels
metrics.rare_labels: MCL has 8 positives over 56 cases: pooled-OOF only, fold-level AUROC declared uninformative in advance
metrics.tie_policy: midrank. Every reported point estimate comes from sklearn.metrics.roc_auc_score. The bootstrap replicates use an equivalent rank-sum implementation (scipy.stats.rankdata) for speed, and the script asserts the two agree to 1e-9 on every label's real scores before building any interval. Section 6 of the EDA notebook's argsort AUROC is reported alongside the LM reference for comparison only, never used as a result.

config.population: the 56 gold studies, parked in split 'excluded' by the holdout cohort so that neither contrastive training nor checkpoint selection could see them; the 2 locked-test gold studies are counted only

probe.fold: StratifiedKFold(shuffle=True), stratification computed inside the per-label fold loop
probe.predictions: exactly one held-out decision_function score per study per label
probe.standardize: StandardScaler fitted inside each training fold
probe.tuning: none; every hyperparameter is fixed here before the first fit

config.purpose: Score the three gold-holdout runs, whose encoder never saw any of the 56 gold studies, against the three published exposed baselines -- in ONE extraction pass so both arms share identical studies, folds and bootstrap resamples. This is the paired contrast pre-registered in digest/gold-holdout-probe-protocol.md.

reference.lm_label_extraction: data/lm_label/*.csv scored against the same gold labels on the same 56 studies, as the text-side label-extraction ceiling

config.scope: Read-only over existing artifacts plus the three gold-holdout runs. No training here, no locked-test evaluation, no writes into any run directory.
